insight: Founded in 2021 by three University of Cambridge graduates; raised a $22M Series A led by Shine Capital.
name: Gizmo
tagline: Gamified AI study app that turns your notes into flashcards and quizzes.
description: Gizmo is a mobile-first study app that turns notes, PDFs, slides, and YouTube videos into adaptive flashcards and quizzes built around spaced repetition and active recall. It wraps studying in game-like mechanics — daily lives, streaks, and bite-sized quizzes — to make revision feel closer to a social app than a textbook. Used by more than 13 million learners across 120 countries, it targets exam prep from GCSEs and A-levels to AP and college courses. A free tier covers daily quizzes and limited tutoring, with paid plans unlocking unlimited use.
edge: Turns studying into a gamified, social-media-style loop — lives, streaks, daily quizzes — to drive retention where plain flashcard apps stall.
pros: Turns notes, PDFs, and videos into quizzes

references.title: AI learning app Gizmo levels up with 13M users and a $22M investment
